question: Can a target-free learned full-width exact-adjoint state expose future spatial closure evidence to P2R0F2J's forward physical recurrence and beat the remaining autonomous OOF and hard-network gaps?

parent_evidence.interpretation: Discard K's generic Gram/context expansion and scalar gain gates. Test one full-width future-conditioned spatial state on top of J. The oracle diagnostic seeds no deployment value and supplies no performance estimate.

data.host_rule: Use the old deterministic host unless max(final_layer_mse,max_layer_mse)>5e-7; all 11 such ranks use the near-floor-min repair.

architecture.name: J forward recurrence conditioned by a learned four-channel full-width backward-adjoint state
architecture.forward_base: P2R0F2J four-channel signed Phi*(state@W) plus diagonal energy/coherence
architecture.backward_order: Compute the complete L15-to-L2 backward scan before the forward scan
architecture.backward_input: raw depth gate plus 19 fold-standardized raw fields, four a/R, four a/(sigma*R), 28 total
architecture.backward_heads: corrected-layer-specific four-source and four-gain heads; gain=1+0.25*tanh; mix=I+0.12*tanh
architecture.forward_input: J's 36 features plus four b/R and four b/(sigma*R), 44 total
architecture.reported_correction: forward state channel zero; no output-only fusion
architecture.material_difference: M learns target-free full-width sources in the exact transpose transport and inserts their future-conditioned spatial state before J's forward errors accumulate. It is not Gram pooling, scalar damping, fixed low-rank projection, or a state-independent Duhamel source.

initialization.module_order: Instantiate and initialize all forward J-descended blocks first, then backward blocks
initialization.linear_trunks: PyTorch nn.Linear default initialization under the fixed fold seed

training.schedule: CosineAnnealingLR over every batch of all six epochs
training.loss: J's fold-normalized corrected-layer rollout plus equal final focus; 2e-5 normalized auxiliary penalty over three nonreported forward plus all four backward states; 5e-4 sum of forward/backward transport-delta and mix-delta mean squares
training.checkpoint: Fixed final epoch 6 in every fold; no early stopping or checkpoint selection

decision_gate.pass: All three unchanged conjuncts pass; then construct and validate a separately frozen M-specific native-Q24 fit/package.
decision_gate.fail: Close this exact bidirectional spelling measured; do not retune from OOF rows or run a second checkpoint.

cost_contract.requirement: Preserve this frozen structural estimate; literal flopscope meter only after accuracy and native-deployment gates pass.

capacity_and_native_q24_firewall.native_inputs_available: The metered live Q24 tape emits raw20, sigma, Phi, and the estimator receives weights
capacity_and_native_q24_firewall.current_native_pilot: P2R0F2J native-tape transfer pilot; it must be terminal before M capacity CV can consume the heavy lane
capacity_and_native_q24_firewall.m_specific_native_requirement: Even if capacity CV passes, M needs a separately frozen native-Q24 fit/verification before deployment

launch_gate.condition: Fold training is forbidden until TRAINING_RELEASE.json binds a terminal native-transfer pilot result and explicit root release.
